acceptanceCriteria: A service-mode dispatcher applies a valid changed config without a restart and keeps the old one on an invalid config, with a test.
The manifest pin semantics are recorded in the spec.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

From the V1-0890 lane (GitHub #645), 2026-10-06: dispatch now reloads a changed config at the next tick, but corvint-tasks service pins the config in its manifest, so a service-mode dispatcher still needs install --replace and a restart to apply config changes.
title: corvint-tasks service: reload the dispatch config without reinstalling
